concerns.text: The plan lacks a verified, open dataset that satisfies the required schema (`material_id, formula, band_gap, hardness, crystal_system`). Without such a dataset the core scientific questions (SC‑001 – SC‑006) cannot be addressed, making the entire research pipeline infeasible. A suitable dataset (e.g., a Materials Project export that includes experimentally or DFT‑derived hardness values) must be identified, cited, and attached before the pipeline can be executed.

Hardness provenance is noted as “unverified” and no source is provided. The specification (FR‑001/SC‑001) requires that all target properties be documented with a reliable origin. The plan must reference a concrete open dataset that includes hardness values (or explicitly replace hardness with a property that is publicly available).
